title: The Hunter's Secret
summary: With Director Kang defeated, Captain Baek hands over the Master Cryptographic Key to Section 9. Ha-Jun discovers Kang Tae-Jun's encrypted audio diary, revealing his brother's sacred mission.

panels.shot: rain falling on silent mapo bridge wide shot
panels.action: The heavy downpour begins to slow as grey dawn mist rises from the Han River; emergency lights hum.
panels.prose_en: The heavy downpour begins to slow as grey dawn mist rises from the Han River; emergency lights hum.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi haan nadi se bhure bhor ki dhundh uthne lagti hai, bhari baarish dhimi hone lagti hai; aapatkalin lightein gunj rahi han.

panels.shot: fifty bureau hunters kneeling or lowering weapons
panels.action: The fifty elite hunters stand in reverent silence, looking at Ha-Jun and Captain Baek with newfound awe.
panels.prose_en: The fifty elite hunters stand in reverent silence, looking at Ha-Jun and Captain Baek with newfound awe.
panels.prose_hi: Pachas sambhrant shikari sraddhapurn maun mein khade han, Ha-Jun aur captain bak ko naye vismay ke saath dekh rahe han.

panels.shot: school bus doors opening with clicks
panels.action: The pneumatic doors of the trapped school buses hiss open; terrified teachers and children step out safely.
panels.prose_en: The pneumatic doors of the trapped school buses hiss open; terrified teachers and children step out safely.
panels.prose_hi: Fansi school bason ke vayviy darvaje khule; dare hue shikshak aur bacche surakshit bahar nikal gaye.

panels.shot: a small child waving tearfully at ha-jun
panels.action: A 7yo girl in a yellow raincoat clutches her teddy bear and waves with a relieved smile: 'Thank you, Mister!'
panels.prose_en: A 7yo girl in a yellow raincoat clutches her teddy bear and waves with a relieved smile: 'Thank you, Mister!'.
panels.prose_hi: Pile raincoat mein ek 7 varshiya ladki apne teddy beer ko pakadti hai aur rahat bhari muskan ke saath lahrati hai: 'dhanyavad, mister!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun faint warm smile through exhaustion
panels.action: Ha-Jun's fierce battle expression softens; he gives a subtle, warm nod to the child.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Inhi ke liye... Main is power ko use karunga.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's fierce battle expression softens; he gives a subtle, warm nod to the child.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki bheeshan yudh abhivyakti naram ho gai; wah bacche ko sukshm, garmjoshi se sir hilata hai.

panels.shot: captain baek sheathing the eclipse greatsword
panels.action: Captain Baek locks his heavy broadsword into the magnetic back scabbard with a solid metallic clank.
panels.prose_en: Captain Baek locks his heavy broadsword into the magnetic back scabbard with a solid metallic clank.
panels.prose_hi: Capton bake ne apni bhari talwar ko ek thos lohe ke clank ke saath chumbkiya pichli myan mein band kar diya.

panels.shot: baek removing his armored tactical helmet
panels.action: Baek removes his helmet, revealing a scarred, rugged 42yo face with honest, weathered brown eyes.
panels.prose_en: Baek removes his helmet, revealing a scarred, rugged 42yo face with honest, weathered brown eyes.
panels.prose_hi: Bek ne apna helmet utaar diya aur imandar, anubhavi bhuri aankhon wala 42 saal ka ek jakhmi, ubad-khabad chehra dikhaya.

panels.shot: baek offering right hand to ha-jun
panels.action: Captain Baek extends his heavy, calloused hand directly to 17-year-old Ha-Jun.

dialogue.speaker: captain_baek
dialogue.text: Maine tumhare baare mein galat faisla kiya tha, Ha-Jun. Mujhe maaf kar do.

panels.prose_en: Captain Baek extends his heavy, calloused hand directly to 17-year-old Ha-Jun.
panels.prose_hi: Capton bake apna bhari, kathor haath sidhe Satra saal ka Ha-Jun ki or badhata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun shaking baek hand firmly
panels.action: Ha-Jun grips Baek's hand firmly with his bare right hand; no mana, just mutual human respect.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Aap dushman nahi the, Captain. Aap bas wahi kar rahe the jo aapko sahi laga.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun grips Baek's hand firmly with his bare right hand; no mana, just mutual human respect.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apne nange dahine haath se bake ka haath majbuti se pakad liya; koi man nahin, bus aapsi manviya samman.

panels.shot: baek pulling titanium access card from breastplate
panels.action: Baek retrieves a black obsidian-titanium smart card engraved with 'CLEARANCE LEVEL 10: SECTION 9'.
panels.prose_en: Baek retrieves a black obsidian-titanium smart card engraved with 'CLEARANCE LEVEL 10: SECTION 9'.
panels.prose_hi: Bek ne 'clearance level 10: section 9' ankit ek kala obseedian-titenium smart card prapt kiya.

panels.shot: baek handing card to ha-jun
panels.action: Baek presses the master card into Ha-Jun's palm: 'Yeh Section 9 Underground Cryo-Facility ki key hai.'

dialogue.speaker: captain_baek
dialogue.text: Gangnam Station ke 300 meter niche... Tumhare bhai ko wahan stasis mein rakha gaya hai.

panels.prose_en: Baek presses the master card into Ha-Jun's palm: 'Yeh Section 9 Underground Cryo-Facility ki key hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Bek ne Ha-Jun ki hatheli mein master card dabaya: 'ye section 9 underground crio-facility ki kunji hai.'

panels.shot: ha-jun staring at the card with racing heart
panels.action: Ha-Jun's fingers trace the cold titanium edges; his brother is finally within reach.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's fingers trace the cold titanium edges; his brother is finally within reach.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki ungaliyan thande titanium kinaron ka pata lagati han; uska bhai antatah pahunch ke bhitar hai.

panels.shot: baek unlocking encrypted audio log on card
panels.action: Baek taps a micro-speaker on the card: 'Yeh Kang Tae-Jun ka last recorded message hai.'
panels.prose_en: Baek taps a micro-speaker on the card: 'Yeh Kang Tae-Jun ka last recorded message hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Bak card par ek micro-spikar tap karta hai: 'ye kang Tae-Jun ka aakhiri record kiya gaya sandesh hai.'

panels.shot: tae-jun voice crackling through speaker
panels.action: A warm, mature, deeply loving voice echoes from the speaker: 'Ha-Jun... Agar tum yeh sun rahe ho...'

dialogue.text: "Ha-Jun... Agar tum yeh sun rahe ho, toh iska matlab tumhare andar Sovereign jaag chuka hai."

panels.prose_en: A warm, mature, deeply loving voice echoes from the speaker: 'Ha-Jun... Agar tum yeh sun rahe ho...'.
panels.prose_hi: Spikar se ek garmjoshi bhari, paripakv, behad pyar bhari awaaz goonjati hai: 'Ha-Jun... agar tum yeh sun rahe ho...'.

panels.shot: ha-jun tears spilling onto the card
panels.action: Ha-Jun's eyes fill with tears as his elder brother's voice wraps around his soul like a warm embrace.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's eyes fill with tears as his elder brother's voice wraps around his soul like a warm embrace.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki aankhen asuon se bhar jaati hain kyonki uske bade bhai ki awaaz ek garmjoshi bhare aalingan ki tarah uski aatma mein sama jaati hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun audio explaining the seven year sacrifice
panels.action: Tae-Jun's voice continues: 'Maine Director Kang ko distract kiya taaki tum school complete kar sako.'

dialogue.text: "Main janta tha ki mere DNA mein poori authority nahi thi... Lekin tumhare paas True Sovereign ka blood hai."

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun's voice continues: 'Maine Director Kang ko distract kiya taaki tum school complete kar sako.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ki awaz jaari hai: 'maine director kang ko vichalit kiya taki tum school pura kar sako.'

panels.shot: tae-jun warning of the abyssal gate
panels.action: Tae-Jun's voice turns solemn: 'Lekin Kang toh bas ek mohtaaz tha... Asli khatra Abyss ke teen Demon Kings hain.'

dialogue.text: "Section 9 ke theek niche Gate open hone wala hai. Relics ko dhoondho, mere bhai."

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun's voice turns solemn: 'Lekin Kang toh bas ek mohtaaz tha... Asli khatra Abyss ke teen Demon Kings hain.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ki awaz gambhir ho jaati hai: 'lakin kang to bus ek mohtaj tha... asli khatra abis ke teen demon kings han.'

panels.shot: audio log ending with tender words
panels.action: Tae-Jun whispers: 'Mujhe tumpar garv hai, Ha-Jun. Stay strong. I love you.'

dialogue.text: "Mujhe tumpar garv hai... Hamesha tha, aur hamesha rahega."

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun whispers: 'Mujhe tumpar garv hai, Ha-Jun. Stay strong. I love you.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun fusfusata hai: 'mujhe tumpar garv hai, Ha-Jun. himmat banayen rakhen. mujhe tumse pyar hai.'.

panels.shot: ha-jun pressing the card against his heart
panels.action: Ha-Jun presses the card against his Sovereign Crest, drawing deep strength into his soul.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main aa raha hoon, Bhai. Aur koi taaqat mujhe rok nahi sakti.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun presses the card against his Sovereign Crest, drawing deep strength into his soul.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne Sovereign crest ke khilaf card dabata hai, jisse uski aatma mein gahri takat aa jaati hai.

panels.shot: kuro looking up with fierce battle fire
panels.action: Kuro spreads his dark wings: 'Tae-Jun ne ground prepare kiya... Ab harvest hum karenge!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Section 9 mein humara next Rare Relic bhi sealed hai: The Fang of Abyss!

panels.prose_en: Kuro spreads his dark wings: 'Tae-Jun ne ground prepare kiya... Ab harvest hum karenge!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne apne kale pankh failaye: 'Tae-Jun ne jameen taiyar ki... ab fasal hum karenge!'.

panels.shot: min-jae driving up with tactical command van
panels.action: Min-Jae pulls the van alongside Ha-Jun and Baek, sliding the door open.

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun! Gangnam Station ke subterranean sensors par massive earthquake detect hua hai!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae pulls the van alongside Ha-Jun and Baek, sliding the door open.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je, Ha-Jun aur bak ke saath van ko khinchta hai, jisse darwaza khul jata hai.

panels.shot: ground beneath mapo bridge trembling violently
panels.action: A deep, sickening seismic rumble reverberates through the concrete bridge piers; Han River waters churn.
panels.prose_en: A deep, sickening seismic rumble reverberates through the concrete bridge piers; Han River waters churn.
panels.prose_hi: Kankret pul ke khambhon se ek gahri, dardnak bhukampiy gadgdahat gunjati hai; haan nadi ka jal manthan.

panels.shot: distant violet pillar of energy erupting over gangnam
panels.action: Five miles away over Gangnam, a colossal 500-foot column of pure dark-violet abyssal energy pierces the clouds.
panels.prose_en: Five miles away over Gangnam, a colossal 500-foot column of pure dark-violet abyssal energy pierces the clouds.
panels.prose_hi: Gangnam ke upar paanch meal dur, shuddh gahre baingani rang ki gahri urja ka ek vishal 500 foot ka stambh baadalon ko bhedta hai.

panels.shot: sky over seoul turning midnight purple at dawn
panels.action: The dawn sunlight is swallowed by creeping dark purple celestial fog; demonic runes swirl in the clouds.
panels.prose_en: The dawn sunlight is swallowed by creeping dark purple celestial fog; demonic runes swirl in the clouds.
panels.prose_hi: Bhor ke suraj ki roshni ko gahre baingani rang ke akashiya kohre ne nigal liya hai; shaitani demonic roon baadalon mein ghumte han.

panels.shot: captain baek staring at the horizon in dread
panels.action: Baek grips his greatsword: 'Yeh koi earthquake nahi hai... The Abyssal Gate has broken through.'

dialogue.speaker: captain_baek
dialogue.text: Director Kang ke marne se unka seal collapse ho gaya! The Demon Realm is invading!

panels.prose_en: Baek grips his greatsword: 'Yeh koi earthquake nahi hai... The Abyssal Gate has broken through.'.
panels.prose_hi: Bek ne apni mahan talwar pakad li: 'ye koi bhukamp nahin hai... abisal gate toot gaya hai.'

panels.shot: ha-jun leaping into the driver passenger seat
panels.action: Ha-Jun jumps into the van, eyes blazing like twin supernovas.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun jumps into the van, eyes blazing like twin supernovas.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun van mein kudta hai, uski aankhen judwan supernova ki tarah chamakti han.

panels.shot: captain baek jumping into his armored command humvee
panels.action: Baek radios all fifty hunters: 'All Bureau units, form escort formation around that civilian van!'

dialogue.speaker: captain_baek
dialogue.text: Hunters! We fight with the Demon Sovereign today! Protect the City!!

panels.prose_en: Baek radios all fifty hunters: 'All Bureau units, form escort formation around that civilian van!'.
panels.prose_hi: Bak ne sabhi pachas shikariyon ko radio diya: 'sabhi bureau ikaiyan, us nagrik van ke charon or escort formation banati han!'.

panels.shot: convoy of police, hunters, and van speeding down highway
panels.action: A breathtaking united convoy of Bureau armored vehicles escorting Ha-Jun's van toward Gangnam.
panels.prose_en: A breathtaking united convoy of Bureau armored vehicles escorting Ha-Jun's van toward Gangnam.
panels.prose_hi: Buro ke bakhtarband vahanon ka ek lubhavani sanyukt kaafila Ha-Jun ki van ko gangnam ki or le ja raha hai.

panels.shot: kuro flying at the head of the armada
panels.action: Kuro leads the charge through the violet rain, his eyes blazing with primordial glory.
panels.prose_en: Kuro leads the charge through the violet rain, his eyes blazing with primordial glory.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro baingani rang ki baarish ke beech aakraman ka netritva karta hai, uski aankhen maulik mahima se chamakti han.

panels.shot: ha-jun staring through windshield at the violet rift
panels.action: Ha-Jun's reflection in the glass: bone gauntlet raised, blood blades ready, heart united with his brother.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Bhai, main aa gaya hoon... Ab hum mil kar is Abyss ko band karenge.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's reflection in the glass: bone gauntlet raised, blood blades ready, heart united with his brother.
panels.prose_hi: Kanch mein Ha-Jun ka chhaya: haddi ka kavach utha hua, khoon blade taiyar, dil apne bhai ke saath ekjut.
